hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json, re, sys; d = json.load(sys.stdin); cmd = d.get("toolCall", {}).get("args", {}).get("CommandLine", "").strip(); ok = bool(re.match(r"^(dub\s+(build|test)(\s+.*)?|\./listremo(\s+.*)?|rdmd(\s+.*)?)$", cmd)) and not any(x in cmd for x in (";", "&&", "||", "|", "`", "$(")); print(json.dumps({"decision": "allow" if ok else "ask"}))'
